objectives:
In this course, students will expect to:

	Communicate fluently and effectively

	Cultivate a critical understanding of the English language in the context of storytelling marketing

	Participate in various in-class presentations (individual and group) and develop a sense of linguistic community
content: This is a public speaking class. Its goal is to train students to communicate with people on a specific topic in a public forum using a formal presentation style. Students will learn speech theories in relation to presentation structure, storytelling techniques, visual aids, body language, etc. The course is made of three sub-categories: storytelling, joining the conversation, and debate, followed by in-class drills as well as standard presentations. Students who take this course should expect to conduct individual projects or group presentations on a regular basis throughout the semester.
books: There will be NO course reader. All course material, if needed, will be provided by the instructor in class in hardcopy.
